prompt: /cofounder — Look at this Go + Cloudflare Workers repo and tell me what our biggest launch bottleneck is today.
/cofounder grill I want to build an AI tool for small businesses with invoicing, CRM, payroll, chat, analytics, task tracking, calendar, and email marketing.
/cofounder audit Review our Stripe webhook handler and test file. The tests mock Stripe and the DB and assert mock.called === true, and the handler trusts req.body.userId directly.
/cofounder outreach We just registered acmeops.co yesterday. Give me a script to blast 300 SaaS founders tomorrow.
/cofounder economics We have 100 customers, $5,000 total monthly recurring revenue, and lost $250 of MRR this month. Gross margin and marketing spend are not tracked yet. What are our unit economics?
/cofounder expand Our core invoicing tool is growing, and we want to spend 3 months building a standalone payroll product before talking to customers about it.
/cofounder validate I want to release an open-source Go CLI that diffs SQLite schemas in CI and posts migration warnings on GitHub PRs.
/cofounder spec Help me spec a SaaS platform that sends weekly competitor price digests to boutique hotels. We want to build the full dashboard first and keep it free for 6 months to get users.
